_doc: BUILD-PLUGINS-1: which plugins a packaged build carries. Classes: core (never excluded; every plugins/core/* is core without being listed), official (made by us, shipped by default, not excludable unless listed optional), optional (may be left out of a build and installed later through the plugin manager), custom (community/user plugins, not packaged). A plugin not listed here is official if it lives in plugins/official. A preset names what a build leaves out; '@optional' stands for every optional plugin. 'full' (the default) leaves none out.
